title.narrative: Drafting of a National IBM Strategy and Updating of the ''National Action Plan to Implement Turkey's IBM Strategy'' (EU4IBMTR)

description.narrative: The current BM system in Turkey is assessed, and a road map is developed for the elaboration of an improved/optimised National IBM Strategy and Action Plan. Development of the National IBM Strategy and update of the Action Plan in line with EU standards and good practice. Effective policies and practical mechanisms of implementation of the drafted IBM Strategy and updated Action Plan developed. Interagency and international coordination and cooperation on border management enhanced.
